name: simple-context-memory
description: Structured, decision-focused memory for Claude Code sessions. Four slash commands — /opening, /closing, /report, /reopen — implement a surgical shift-handoff model so every session starts oriented instead of cold, plus a paired claude-reopen shell tool to jump back into an exact past session. Captures what was decided and why, what was rejected, implicit assumptions, where the agent struggled, and what's still open.
